newsitem.title: UK: West Brom kicks off at 240.00 stg per share.
newsitem.headline: West Brom kicks off at 240.00 stg per share.

text.p: English football club West Bromwich Albion Plc made its debut on London's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on Friday with a single trade at a price of 240.00 stg a share.

"We've had 50 shares crossed at 240 pounds a share but we won't know the true price for a few days -- not until the market settles down and we have a few more trades," said a dealer at Albert E. Sharp, the agency broker which sponsored the placing.
Winterflood Securities, the sole market maker for the share, quoted a mid-price of 280.00 stg at 1210 GMT.
